reviews.text:
I was lucky enough to photograph a wedding at Highland Farms in October, and I was completely blown away. Tucked into the forest in the foothills of Mt. Hood, this venue truly feels like something out of a fairytale. As soon as you arrive, you’re welcomed by a cozy mountain-style lodge, a beautiful barn, and even a grazing area for their family of Highland cows, which adds so much charm to the property.

Highland Farms offers multiple on-site lodging options for you and your guests, along with thoughtful amenities like a sauna and hot tub for relaxing and unwinding. The ceremony space is stunning, featuring a stone patio, a peaceful pond, and towering evergreens that create such an intimate, natural atmosphere. The forest trails are lined with hazelnut shells instead of dirt, it’s a small touch that makes the entire experience feel elevated and intentional. The reception area, located beside the lodge, is another stone patio that’s perfect for an intimate gathering of around 50 guests. If you’re considering Highland Farms for your wedding, I can’t recommend it enough

We had the most amazing time at Highland Farms! From start to finish, the farm tour was such a special experience. The property itself is beautiful, and getting up close with all the animals made it unforgettable—friendly dogs, stunning peacocks, the sweetest Highland cows, and adorable sheep. Every part of the tour felt thoughtful and engaging, and you can really tell how much care and love goes into this place.

Huge shoutout to Dante, our tour guide—he was incredible! Super knowledgeable, informative, and genuinely funny, which made the whole experience even better. He shared so much about the farm and the animals while keeping things fun and relaxed. We left with big smiles and great memories. Highly recommend Highland Farms to anyone looking for a unique, hands-on, and joyful farm experience 🐄🌾🦚

We did the private tour for two and had so much fun meeting the cows and all the animals of Highland Farms! Our tour guide Dante was incredibly passionate and clearly had a lot of pride in taking care of the property and the animals. He introduced us to each of the cows and taught us how to brush and feed them! Afterwards, Jalene spoke to us about the history of the farm and answered all my burning questions about what it’s like to take care of the newborn cows. Def recommend if you want to have a unique  date just outside the city. And shoutout to Cowboy the barn cat who accompanied us on our tour and made sure things ran smoothly :)

I wanted to surprise my friend with a little cow cuddling session (most precisely highland cows cause she loves them) and I started looking up at places around Portland where to go do that.

I stumbled upon different websites and also different videos on TikTok and Instagram.
But nothing caught my attention like Highland Farm.

I was interested not only in the Private Tour for Two but also potentially staying the night.

I reached out asking for more info and Connor, the owner, called me back and answered all my questions and was very kind and understanding, although I know farm life can be very busy.

I noticed that on the website it said the airstream wasn’t available (probably because of the season - as it’s rainy in Oregon at the moment) but he told me he was gonna look into making sure of the different staying options and was going to call me back.

After just a little while he called me back and explained the different options, with prices and capacity of the place.

I ended up booking only the experience as I wanted to surprise my friend mostly with the tour and spending time with the cows.

We were a little worried about the rain, but I texted Connor and asked if the tour was still taking place and if we needed to watch out for the drive there.
He assured us the tour would’ve taken place in the barn and that everything was going according to plan.

When my friend and I got there, we were surprised by how beautiful the place was, despite the rain.
It was actually giving the classic pnw vibes.

As soon as we got there, we saw a pen on the left with two highland cows - we later found out those were pregnant ones - and a huge statue in the front.

Plenty of parking on the right hand of the entrance, and I previously got a message with instructions to park there and wait near the statue for our tour guides.

We were able to admire the pregnant cows on the left and we got approached by three tour guides - Ellery, AJ and Jace.

We talked a bit there and then they gave us the perfect tour of the property.
We started with the barn, where we admire a few animals and learned fun facts about them and their names, and we also got to pet Arthur - beautiful black highland cow.

Another cow just had a little calf, and so we spent some time admiring them, and we hope the little calf will be named Maisy.

We personally loved to know all sorts of fun facts about their animals, and knowing they try to include the “fans/supporters” as much as possible, like having polls on their socials to pick the animals’ names.

Ellery, AJ and Jace were incredibly nice, we talked a lot and it felt like we were all friends.
They’re very easy going and they don’t judge the lack of knowledge, nor the amount of questions I had.
They actually answered and were super friendly.
In addition to their phenomenal personality, they have a phenomenal knowledge of the farm.

They explained to us about the animals, the staying, the property and the wild life around the property.
We had - an have - nothing but compliments, and we loved the explanation of how the farm turned into the beautiful place it is today.

I am a photographer and just fell in love with the venue.
They also have beautiful sections for weddings.
The lodge is beautiful, all in natural wood and with multiple rooms, which could be perfect for a bridal suite type of moment.
And the groom with the groomsmen could stay in the cottage, which has three rooms and a nice living room.

Overall this experience has been absolutely amazing!
I will definitely be back, bring my friends, stay a few nights, and I definitely hope I’ll be able to see Ellery, AJ and Jace again.

And huge congratulations to the owner Connor for creating such a diverse paradise, from nature lover to fancy wedding venue.

My husband and I had a little couples getaway with our other couple friends this past weekend at the Highland Farm.
The location is absolutely stunning, quiet, calming, clean and of course the cows make it so special and unique from other stays. The soaking tub by the cottage was so relaxing. The cottage had all the amenities we needed as well as some beautiful farm fresh eggs. We got to do the farm tour, meet the cows, pet them and take photos. The cows are incredibly tame and friendly, just giant puppies that love attention, so we had a ton of fun hanging out with them. We also did the new spa experience with the cold plunge, sauna and steam room which was all incredibly luxurious and rejuvenating.
The staff was very friendly and accommodating for our stay.
We had a great time walking the property and enjoying the sounds of the fresh stream, nature and the animals. This place has so much to offer.
We’ll definitely be back.
